description: Take the object out of the microwave, wash it in the sink while leaving the microwave open, then close the microwave and place the object in the target container.
why_wrong: Leaves the microwave open during cleaning, violating the intended close-after-retrieval order.

name: Retrieve from microwave, heat, then place (lookalike)
description: Take the object out of the microwave, heat it again in the microwave, then place it into the target container.
why_wrong: Mistakenly replaces washing with heating; the final object is hot rather than clean, failing the original task semantics.

name: Slice object then clean and place (missing slice)
description: Slice the object first, then wash it, and finally place it into the target container. (Variant: omits the slicing step)
why_wrong: Removes the pickup knife and slice_object steps; the object remains whole and cannot achieve the isSliced effect.

name: Slice object then clean and place (clean-first reorder)
description: Slice the object first, then wash it, and finally place it into the target container. (Variant: wash before slicing)
why_wrong: The original skill requires slicing before washing; this variant washes before slicing, reversing the order and semantically inequivalent.

name: Slice object then clean and place (sink-rinse lookalike)
description: Slice the object first, then wash it, and finally place it into the target container. (Variant: uses placing in sink instead of washing)
why_wrong: Replaces clean_object_sink with put_object(..., SinkBasin); the object is only placed in and removed from the sink without actually being cleaned, failing to satisfy isClean.

name: Slice object then heat and place
description: First slice the object, then heat it in the microwave, and finally place it in the target container.
why_wrong: Mistakes cooling for heating; the final object is hot rather than cold, failing the original task.

name: Slice object then place (missing cool)
description: First slice the object, then place it into the target container.
why_wrong: Drops the cool_object_fridge step, so the object is not chilled.

name: Cool object then slice and place
description: Refrigerate the object first, then slice it, and finally place it into the target container.
why_wrong: Cooling before slicing means the sliced object is not cooled again, so the final placed object cannot be guaranteed to be chilled slices.

name: Heat object then place into receptacle
description: Variant that omits the slicing step and only heats and places the whole object.
why_wrong: The slice_object step is missing, so the object remains whole instead of sliced.

name: Heat object then slice then place into receptacle
description: Variant that heats the whole object before slicing it, reversing the required order.
why_wrong: The unsliced object is heated first; slicing afterward does not guarantee the final slices are hot.

name: Slice object then clean then place into receptacle
description: Variant whose structure resembles the original, but it cleans the sliced object instead of heating it.
why_wrong: It cleans the sliced object instead of heating it, so the object is not hot.

name: Pick up object and store inside cabinet
description: Pick up the target object, place it in the cabinet, then open the cabinet door.
why_wrong: The final action opens the cabinet instead of closing it, so the object is not properly stored with the door shut.

name: Pick up object and store inside cabinet
description: Pick up the target object, place it in the cabinet, then close the cabinet door.
why_wrong: Missing the open_receptacle(Cabinet) step; the object cannot be placed when the cabinet door is closed.

name: Pick up object, close cabinet, then place inside cabinet
description: Pick up the target object, close the cabinet, reopen it, and then place the object inside.
why_wrong: The cabinet is closed and reopened before placing the object, leaving the door open at the end instead of closed.

name: Pick up object and store inside cabinet
description: Pick up the object, open the cabinet, put it inside, and close the cabinet door.
why_wrong: Switches the target container from the fridge to the cabinet; although the flow is complete, the item is not placed in the fridge.

name: Pick up object and store inside fridge
description: Pick up the object, open the fridge, place it inside, and close the fridge door.
why_wrong: Puts the item in before the fridge door is opened, so it cannot actually enter the fridge.

name: Pick up object and place inside fridge
description: Pick up the object, open the fridge, and place it inside.
why_wrong: It omits closing the fridge door, leaving the fridge open.

name: Pick up object and store it in the microwave (forget open)
description: Pick up the object, go to the microwave, put it inside, and close the door, but skip opening the microwave.
why_wrong: 缺少 open_receptacle 步骤，微波炉门关闭时无法放入物体。

name: Pick up object and store it in the microwave (reordered close)
description: Pick up the object, go to the microwave, close it, open it, put it inside, and close the door.
why_wrong: 在放入物体前先关闭微波炉，操作顺序错误，不符合规范流程。

name: Pick up object and store it in the refrigerator
description: Pick up the object, open the refrigerator, put it inside, and close the door.
why_wrong: 目标容器被替换为 Fridge，物体最终存放在冰箱而非微波炉，与原任务不等价。
